name: Career Command Resume + Job Fit Audit
problem: A job seeker has a real opening and needs an evidence-backed comparison between their supplied background and the target role without fabricated credentials or fake proprietary ATS certainty.
use_when: check my resume against this job
why am I not getting interviews
tailor my resume to this opening
what am I missing for this job
inputs: Candidate-supplied resume or background plus the target job description. Optional skills, achievements and company context.
outputs: Strongest proof anchors, job-fit evidence, generic or unsupported claims, missing evidence, highest-impact edits and a truthful rewritten summary.
pricing: Free core is available. No premium machine-lane price is approved yet.
confirmation: No payment obligation is created. Any future paid premium action requires explicit user confirmation and verified payment.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
